title: 6. National Pension System (NPS) – VERY HIGH PROBABILITY

blocks.content: The National Pension System is a voluntary, long-term retirement savings scheme regulated by PFRDA.
The National Pension System is a voluntary, long-term retirement savings scheme regulated by PFRDA.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The National Pension System (NPS) is structured as a voluntary financial scheme.
It is intended specifically for long-term retirement savings.
Regulatory oversight and control of the NPS are handled by the PFRDA.
Regulating Body: PFRDA regulates the National Pension System (NPS).
Scheme Nature: NPS is a voluntary and long-term retirement savings scheme.

cells: 2004 (for government employees); later opened to all citizens)
